translations.idiomatic: Yon's faction Pei Zhongsun and others again gathered remnant troops, set up Chung's collateral the Marquis of Seonghwa as king, and fled to Jin Island.

sentences.zh: 」大軍次王京西關城，遣人收繫林衍妻子。

translations.literal: The great army halted at Wangjing West Pass Fortress and sent men to arrest Im Yon's wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: The main army halted at Wangjing West Pass Fortress and sent men to arrest Im Yon's wife and children.

sentences.zh: 行省與禃議遷江華島居民於王京，仍宣詔撫綏之，禃弗從，至入居其舊京，始從行省之議。

translations.literal: The Secretariat and Chung discussed moving Jianghua Island residents to the royal capital and proclaiming an edict to soothe them; Chung did not comply until he took up residence in his old capital, when he at last followed the Secretariat's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat and Chung discussed moving Jianghua Island residents to the royal capital and issuing a soothing edict; Chung refused until he took up residence in his old capital, when he at last followed the Secretariat's proposal.

sentences.zh: 六月，禃遣人報有朝廷逃軍與承化侯者以三別抄軍叛。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Chung sent word reporting that court fugitive soldiers together with the Marquis of Seonghwa had rebelled with the Three Special Striking Forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Chung reported that court fugitive soldiers together with the Marquis of Seonghwa had rebelled with the Three Special Striking Forces.

sentences.zh: 世子愖復言：「叛兵據江華島，宜率軍水陸進擊之。

translations.literal: The heir Prince Sim again said: "The rebel troops hold Jianghua Island; we ought to lead armies by land and water to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sim again said, "The rebel troops hold Jianghua Island; we ought to lead armies by land and water to attack them.

sentences.zh: 」禃復報叛兵悉遁去。

translations.literal: Chung again reported that the rebel troops had all fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Chung again reported that the rebel troops had all fled.

sentences.zh: 世子愖言：「叛兵劫府庫，燒圖籍，逃入海中。

translations.literal: Prince Sim said: "The rebel troops raided the treasury, burned the archives, and fled into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sim said, "The rebel troops raided the treasury, burned the archives, and fled into the sea.

sentences.zh: 」行省使人覘江華島中百姓皆空，島之東南，相距約四十里，叛兵乘船候風，勢欲遁。

translations.literal: The Secretariat sent men to observe—within Jianghua Island all the people were empty; to the island's southeast, about forty li apart, the rebel troops waited for wind in boats intending to flee.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat sent men to observe: within Jianghua Island the people were all gone; to the southeast, about forty li away, the rebels waited for wind in boats intending to flee.

sentences.zh: 於是即命乃顏率衆追擊之。

translations.literal: Then Nayyan was immediately ordered to lead troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Nayyan was immediately ordered to lead troops in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 七月，丞相安童等言，頭輦哥等遣大托、忙古來言，令阿海領軍一千五百，屯王京伺察其國中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Chancellor An Tong and others said Tounaige and others had sent Datuo and Mangulai saying Ahai should lead fifteen hundred troops to garrison Wangjing and observe the country.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Chancellor An Tong and others said Tounaige had sent Datuo and Mangulai requesting that Ahai lead fifteen hundred troops to garrison Wangjing and observe the country.

sentences.zh: 遂以阿海為安撫使。

translations.literal: Ahai was then made pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ahai was then made pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月，中書省臣言於高麗設置屯田經略司。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Secretariat members proposed establishing a Garrison-Farm Strategic Commission in Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Secretariat members proposed establishing a Garrison-Farm Strategic Commission in Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 以忻都、史樞為鳳州等處經略使，佩虎符，領軍五千屯田於金州；

translations.literal: Xindu and Shi Shu were made strategic commissioners of Feng Prefecture and elsewhere, wearing tiger tallies, leading five thousand troops to farm garrisons at Jin Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Xindu and Shi Shu were made strategic commissioners of Feng Prefecture and elsewhere, wearing tiger tallies, leading five thousand troops to garrison-farm at Jin Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 又令洪茶丘以舊領民二千屯田，阿剌帖木兒為副經略司，緫轄之，而罷阿海軍。

translations.literal: Hong Chaqiu was also ordered to farm garrisons with his old followers of two thousand households; Alatiemuer was deputy strategic commissioner overseeing them, and Ahai's army was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chaqiu was also ordered to garrison-farm with his two thousand former households; Alatiemuer was deputy strategic commissioner overseeing them, and Ahai's army was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月，世子愖還。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month the heir Prince Sim returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month Prince Sim returned.

sentences.zh: 有詔諭禃以其陪臣元傅等妄奏頭輦哥國王為頭行省官員數事，及其國私與南宋、日本交通，又往年所言括兵造船至今未有成效，且謂自此以往或先有事南宋，或先有事日本，兵馬、船艦、資糧，早宜措置。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Chung regarding his attendant ministers Won Bu and others falsely memorializing matters such as Tounaige the king being head Secretariat official, and their country's private contacts with Southern Song and Japan, and also that conscription and shipbuilding spoken of in former years have to this day shown no results—and said that henceforth whether there is first business with Southern Song or first with Japan, troops, ships, and provisions should be arranged early.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Chung regarding his ministers Won Bu and others falsely memorializing that Tounaige the king was head Secretariat official, their country's private contacts with Southern Song and Japan, and that conscription and shipbuilding promised in former years had shown no results—and said that henceforth, whether the campaign came first against Southern Song or Japan, troops, ships, and provisions should be arranged early.

sentences.zh: 是月，又詔禃曰：「嚮嘗遣信使通問日本，不謂執迷固難以善言開諭，此卿所知。

translations.literal: That month another edict said to Chung: "Formerly envoys were sent to communicate with Japan; who would have thought they would cling to obstinacy and be hard to open with good words—this you know.
translations.idiomatic: That month another edict said to Chung, "Formerly envoys were sent to Japan; who would have thought they would cling to obstinacy and refuse good counsel—you know this.

sentences.zh: 將經略於彼，敕有司發卒屯田，為進取之計，庶免爾國他日轉輸之勞。

translations.literal: We are about to plan operations there; orders have been issued to send soldiers to garrison-farm as preparations for advance, so as to spare your country the labor of transport in future.
translations.idiomatic: We are about to plan operations there; orders have been issued to garrison-farm as preparations for advance, so as to spare your country future transport burdens.

sentences.zh: 仍遣使持書，先示招懷。

translations.literal: Envoys are again sent bearing letters first to show invitation and appeasement.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys are again sent with letters first offering invitation and appeasement.

sentences.zh: 卿其悉心盡慮，俾贊方略，期於有成，以稱朕意。

translations.literal: You must devote heart and mind to assist the strategy, expecting achievement, to match my intent."
translations.idiomatic: You must devote your full mind to assist the strategy and achieve results, to match my intent."

sentences.zh: 」初，林衍之變，百姓驚擾，至是下詔撫慰之。

translations.literal: Initially, because of Im Yon's revolt the people were alarmed; now an edict was issued to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Im Yon's revolt had alarmed the people; now an edict was issued to comfort them.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔諭禃送使通好日本，曰：「朕惟日本自昔通好中國，實相密邇，故嘗詔卿導達去使，講信修睦，為其疆吏所梗，竟不獲明諭朕心。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict instructed Chung to send envoys to open relations with Japan, saying: "I consider that Japan from of old has been on friendly terms with China and is truly close; therefore I once ordered you to guide departing envoys to speak faith and cultivate amity, but their border officials obstructed it and in the end my heart could not be clearly made known.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict instructed Chung to send envoys to Japan, saying, "Japan from of old has been on friendly terms with China and is truly close; therefore I once ordered you to guide envoys to speak faith and cultivate amity, but border officials obstructed them and my intent could not be made clear.

sentences.zh: 後以林衍之亂，故不暇及。

translations.literal: Later, because of Im Yon's disorder, there was no leisure for this.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because of Im Yon's disorder, there was no leisure for this.

sentences.zh: 今既輯寧爾家，遣少中大夫、祕書監趙良弼充國信使，期於必達。

translations.literal: Now that your house is settled, Junior Minister and Secretariat Director Zhao Liangbi is sent as credentialed envoy, with the deadline that he must arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Now that your house is settled, Junior Minister and Secretariat Director Zhao Liangbi is sent as credentialed envoy, and he must reach Japan.

sentences.zh: 仍以忽林赤、王國昌、洪茶丘將兵送抵海上。

translations.literal: Hulinci, Wang Guochang, and Hong Chaqiu are also to lead troops escorting them to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Hulinci, Wang Guochang, and Hong Chaqiu will also lead troops escorting them to the sea.

sentences.zh: 比國信使還，姑令金州等處屯駐。

translations.literal: When the credentialed envoys return, for the time being troops are to be stationed at Jin Prefecture and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: When the credentialed envoys return, troops are for the time being to be stationed at Jin Prefecture and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 所需糧餉，卿專委官赴彼，逐近供給，并鳩集金州旁左船艦，於金州需待，無致稽緩匱乏。」

translations.literal: Required grain rations—you should specially appoint officials to go there to supply from nearby, and also assemble ships near Jin Prefecture, waiting at Jin Prefecture without causing delay or shortage."
translations.idiomatic: Required grain—you should appoint officials to supply from nearby, and assemble ships near Jin Prefecture to wait there without delay or shortage."

sentences.zh: 八年正月，禃遣其樞密使金鍊奉表入見，請結婚。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year Chung sent his privy councilor Kim Ryun with a memorial to audience, requesting a marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year Chung sent his privy councilor Kim Ryun to audience with a memorial requesting a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 安撫使阿海略地珍島，與逆黨遇，多所亡失。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Ahai pacified Jin Island territory and met the rebels, suffering many losses.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Ahai pacified Jin Island and met the rebels, suffering heavy losses.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言諜知珍島餘糧將竭，宜乘弱攻之，詔不許。

translations.literal: Secretariat members said spies reported Jin Island's remaining grain would soon be exhausted and it would be well to attack while weak; an edict did not permit this.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat members said spies reported Jin Island's grain would soon be exhausted and it would be well to attack while weak; an edict refused.

sentences.zh: 二月，命忽都荅兒持詔諭裴仲孫。

translations.literal: In the second month Hududaer was ordered to carry an edict instructing Pei Zhongsun.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Hududaer was ordered to carry an edict instructing Pei Zhongsun.

sentences.zh: 三月，仲孫乞諸軍退屯，然後內附，忻都未從其請，有詔諭之。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhongsun begged the armies to withdraw before he would submit inward; Xindu did not accede—an edict instructed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhongsun begged the armies to withdraw before he would submit; Xindu refused—an edict instructed him.

sentences.zh: 四月，忻都言仲孫稽留詔使，負固不服，乞與虎林赤、王國昌分道進討，從之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Xindu said Zhongsun detained the imperial envoys and remained stubborn; he begged to campaign with Hulinci and Wang Guochang by separate routes—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Xindu said Zhongsun detained the imperial envoys and remained stubborn; he asked to campaign with Hulinci and Wang Guochang by separate routes—granted.

sentences.zh: 以討珍島諭禃。

translations.literal: The campaign against Jin Island was announced to Chung.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign against Jin Island was announced to Chung.

sentences.zh: 五月，忻都與史樞、洪茶丘大敗珍島賊，獲承化侯斬之，其黨金通精走耽羅。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xindu with Shi Shu and Hong Chaqiu greatly defeated the Jin Island bandits, captured the Marquis of Seonghwa and beheaded him; his follower Kim Tongjeong fled to Tamna.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xindu with Shi Shu and Hong Chaqiu greatly defeated the Jin Island rebels, captured and beheaded the Marquis of Seonghwa; his follower Kim Tongjeong fled to Tamna.

sentences.zh: 七月，禃遣其上將軍鄭子璵奉表謝平珍島。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Chung sent his supreme general Jeong Jau with a memorial thanking the pacification of Jin Island.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Chung sent his supreme general Jeong Jau with a memorial thanking the pacification of Jin Island.

sentences.zh: 世子愖率其尚書右丞宋玢、軍器監薛公儉等衣冠胤冑二十八人入侍。

translations.literal: The heir Prince Sim led his Right Vice Minister of the Secretariat Song Bin, Armory Commissioner Xue Gongjian, and twenty-eight men of the gentry and official families to serve at court.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sim led his Right Vice Minister Song Bin, Armory Commissioner Xue Gongjian, and twenty-eight sons of the gentry and official families to serve at court.

sentences.zh: 八月，忽林赤赴鎮邊合浦縣屯所。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Hulinci went to his garrison-post at Hepu County on the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Hulinci went to his border garrison at Hepu County.

sentences.zh: 九月，禃遣其通事別將徐偁導送宣撫趙良弼使日本。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Chung sent his interpreting vice commandant Seo Eung to guide Pacification Commissioner Zhao Liangbi's mission to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chung sent his interpreting vice commandant Seo Eung to guide Pacification Commissioner Zhao Liangbi's mission to Japan.

sentences.zh: 帝遣愖還國。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent Sim back to his country.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent Sim back to his country.

sentences.zh: 十一月，禃遣其同知樞密院事李昌慶奉表謝許婚事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Chung sent his Privy Council vice commissioner Li Changgyeong with a memorial thanking permission for the marriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Chung sent his Privy Council vice commissioner Li Changgyeong with a memorial thanking permission for the marriage.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，禃遣其別將白琚偕張鐸等十二人奉表入見。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year Chung sent his vice commandant Baek Gu with Zhang Duo and twelve others presenting a memorial at audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year Chung sent his vice commandant Baek Gu with Zhang Duo and twelve others to audience with a memorial.

sentences.zh: 世子愖以其國尚書右丞宋玢、玢父上將軍宗禮討林惟茂狀，言其功于中書省。

translations.literal: The heir Prince Sim, through his Vice Minister Song Bin and Bin's father supreme general Song Jongni's account of campaigning against Im Yuimao, spoke of their merit to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sim, through his Vice Minister Song Bin and Bin's father supreme general Song Jongni's account of campaigning against Im Yuimao, reported their merit to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遣郎中不花、馬璘使高麗，諭以供戰船輸軍糧事。

translations.literal: Director Bulhua and Ma Lin were sent to Goryeo to instruct on supplying war ships and military grain.
translations.idiomatic: Director Bulhua and Ma Lin were sent to Goryeo to instruct on supplying warships and military grain.

sentences.zh: 二月，禃致書日本，使通好于朝。

translations.literal: In the second month Chung sent a letter to Japan to open relations with the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Chung sent a letter to Japan to open relations with the court.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣西京屬城諸達魯花赤及質子金鎰等歸國。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the darughachi of dependent cities of the Western Capital and hostages including Kim Eui were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the darughachi of the Western Capital's dependent cities and hostages including Kim Eui were sent home.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，禃遣其世子愖入朝。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year Chung sent his heir Prince Sim to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year Chung sent his heir Prince Sim to court.

sentences.zh: 四月，經略使忻都同洪茶丘領兵入海，攻拔耽羅城，禽金通精等，奉詔誅之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Strategic Commissioner Xindu together with Hong Chaqiu led troops onto the sea, stormed and took Tamna fortress, captured Kim Tongjeong and others, and by imperial order executed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Strategic Commissioner Xindu with Hong Chaqiu led troops to sea, captured Tamna fortress, seized Kim Tongjeong and others, and executed them by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 六月，禃遣其大將軍金忻表奏攻破濟州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Chung sent his great general Kim Heon with a memorial reporting the storming of Jeju.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Chung sent his great general Kim Heon with a memorial reporting the capture of Jeju.

sentences.zh: 九月，禃屢言：「小國地狹，比歲荒歉，其生券軍乞駐東京，」詔令營北京界，仍敕東京路運米二萬石賑之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Chung repeatedly said: "Our small country's land is narrow; in recent years there has been famine; the bond-servant soldiers beg to be stationed at Dongjing"—an edict ordered camps set on the Beijing frontier, and Dongjing Circuit was charged to transport twenty thousand piculs of rice for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chung repeatedly said, "Our small country is narrow; famine has struck in recent years; the bond-servant soldiers beg to be stationed at Dongjing"—an edict ordered camps on the Beijing frontier, and Dongjing Circuit was charged to transport twenty thousand piculs of rice for relief.

sentences.zh: 達魯花赤焦天翼還朝。

translations.literal: Darughachi Jiao Tianyi returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Darughachi Jiao Tianyi returned to court.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，黑的還朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, seventh month, Hei Di returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, seventh month, Hei Di returned to court.

sentences.zh: 十一月，遣使諭愖改官職名號，愖遣其帶方侯王澂率衣冠子弟二十人入侍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month envoys were sent instructing Sim to change office titles; Sim sent his Marquis of Daebang Wang Seung leading twenty gentry sons to serve at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month envoys were sent instructing Sim to change office titles; Sim sent his Marquis of Daebang Wang Seung with twenty gentry sons to serve at court.

sentences.zh: 以石抹天衢充副達魯花赤。

translations.literal: Shimotianqu was appointed vice darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: Shimotianqu was appointed vice darughachi.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月，愖遣其僉議中贊金方慶奉表賀平宋。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, seventh month, Sim sent his Consultation Counselor Kim Banggyeong with a memorial congratulating the pacification of Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, seventh month, Sim sent his Consultation Counselor Kim Banggyeong with a memorial congratulating the pacification of Song.

sentences.zh: 十一月，愖遣其判祕書寺事朱悅奉表，奏改名賰。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Sim sent his Acting Secretariat Director Ju Yeol with a memorial requesting a name change to Seung.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Sim sent his Acting Secretariat Director Ju Yeol with a memorial requesting a name change to Seung.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，金方慶等為亂，命愖治之，仍命忻都、洪茶丘飭兵禦備。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year Kim Banggyeong and others caused disorder; Sim was ordered to punish them; Xindu and Hong Chaqiu were still ordered to ready troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourteenth year Kim Banggyeong and others caused disorder; Sim was ordered to punish them; Xindu and Hong Chaqiu were ordered to ready troops in defense.

sentences.zh: 十五年一月，賰以達魯花赤石抹天衢秩滿未代，請復留三年，從之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year Seung, because vice darughachi Shimotianqu's term had expired without replacement, asked he remain three more years—granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year Seung, because vice darughachi Shimotianqu's term had expired without replacement, asked that he remain three more years—granted.

sentences.zh: 東征元帥府上言：「以高麗侍中金方慶與其子羌、愃、恂，壻趙抃等，陰養死士四百人，匿鎧仗器械，造戰艦，積糧餉，欲謀作亂，捕方慶等按驗得實，已流諸海島。

translations.literal: The Eastern Campaign Marshal's Office memorialized: "Goryeo attendant Kim Banggyeong with his sons Qiang, Hwan, Sun, son-in-law Zhao Bian and others secretly maintained four hundred dead soldiers, hid armor and weapons and implements, built warships, stored grain—all plotting rebellion; capturing and investigating Banggyeong et al. the facts were obtained and they have been exiled to sea islands.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Campaign Marshal's Office memorialized: "Goryeo attendant Kim Banggyeong with his sons Qiang, Hwan, and Sun, son-in-law Zhao Bian, and others secretly maintained four hundred dead soldiers, hid arms and stores, built warships, and stockpiled grain, plotting rebellion; investigation proved the case and they have been exiled to the islands.

sentences.zh: 然高麗初附，民心未安，可發征日本還卒二千七百人，置長吏，屯忠清、全羅諸處，鎮撫外夷，以安其民；

translations.literal: Yet Goryeo has newly submitted and the people's hearts are not yet settled; the returning soldiers from the Japan campaign, twenty-seven hundred men, may be placed with senior officials to garrison Chungcheong and Jeolla and elsewhere to pacify outer barbarians and settle the people;
translations.idiomatic: Yet Goryeo has newly submitted and hearts are not settled; the twenty-seven hundred soldiers returning from the Japan campaign may be placed with senior officials to garrison Chungcheong, Jeolla, and elsewhere to pacify outer tribes and settle the people;

sentences.zh: 復令士卒備牛畜耒耜，為來歲屯田之計。

translations.literal: soldiers are also to prepare oxen, livestock, and ploughs for next year's garrison-farm plan."
translations.idiomatic: soldiers are also to prepare oxen, livestock, and ploughs for next year's garrison-farm plan."

sentences.zh: 」七月，改鑄駙馬高麗王印賜賰。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the seal for the imperial son-in-law Goryeo king was recast and granted to Seung.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the imperial son-in-law Goryeo king's seal was recast and granted to Seung.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，敕其國置大灰艾州、東京、柳石、孛落四驛。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year their country was ordered to establish four post stations: Daehwaai Prefecture, Dongjing, Ryuseok, and Nungnak.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year their country was ordered to establish four post stations: Daehwaai Prefecture, Dongjing, Ryuseok, and Nungnak.

sentences.zh: 十七年五月，賰以民饑，乞貸糧萬石，從之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year Seung, because the people were starving, begged to borrow ten thousand piculs of grain—granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year Seung, because the people were starving, begged to borrow ten thousand piculs of grain—granted.

sentences.zh: 七月，以其國初置驛站，民乏食，命給糧一歲，仍禁使臣往來勿求索飲食。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, because post stations were newly established in their country and the people lacked food, grain for one year was ordered given, and envoys were forbidden to seek food and drink on their journeys.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, because post stations had been newly established and the people lacked food, grain for one year was granted, and envoys were forbidden to demand food and drink on their journeys.

sentences.zh: 十月，加賰開府儀同三司、中書左丞相、行中書省事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Seung was promoted to identical ceremonies with the Three Dukes, Left Chancellor of the Secretariat, and acting Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Seung was promoted to identical ceremonies with the Three Dukes, Left Chancellor of the Secretariat, and acting Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，賰言本國必闍赤不諳行移文字，請除郎中員外各一員以為參佐。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year Seung said their country's bicheke did not understand dispatch documents and requested one director and one assistant director each as aides.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year Seung said their country's bicheke did not understand dispatch documents and requested one director and one assistant director as aides.

sentences.zh: 賰又請易宣命職銜，增駙馬字，從之。

translations.literal: Seung also asked to change the commission title and add the imperial son-in-law designation—granted.
translations.idiomatic: Seung also asked to change the commission title and add the imperial son-in-law designation—granted.

sentences.zh: 六月，賰言本國置驛四十，民畜凋弊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Seung said their country had forty post stations and the people's livestock were depleted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Seung said their country had forty post stations and the people's livestock were depleted.

sentences.zh: 敕併為二十站，仍給馬價八百錠。

translations.literal: An edict merged them into twenty stations and granted eight hundred ingots for horse costs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict merged them into twenty stations and granted eight hundred ingots for horse costs.

sentences.zh: 八月，陞其僉議府為從三品。

translations.literal: In the eighth month their Consultation Office was raised to third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month their Consultation Office was raised to third rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月，金州等處置鎮邊萬戶府，以控制日本。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Border-Pacification Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established at Jin Prefecture and elsewhere to control Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Border-Pacification Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established at Jin Prefecture and elsewhere to control Japan.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月，賰以日本寇其邊海郡邑，燒居室掠子女而去，請發闍里帖木兒麾下蒙古軍五百人戍金州，又從之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year Seung said Japan raided their coastal commanderies and districts, burned dwellings and seized women and children; he begged five hundred Mongol troops under Yalitiemuer be sent to garrison Jin Prefecture—granted again.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year Seung said Japan raided their coastal districts, burned dwellings, and seized women and children; he begged five hundred Mongol troops under Yalitiemuer to garrison Jin Prefecture—granted.

sentences.zh: 二十年五月，立征東行中書省，以高麗國王與阿塔海共事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year the Eastern Campaign Secretariat was established, with the Goryeo king and Atahai sharing the office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twentieth year the Eastern Campaign Secretariat was established, with the Goryeo king and Atahai sharing the office.

sentences.zh: 二十八年五月，以賰子謜為世子，授特進、上柱國，賜銀印。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-eighth year Seung's son Eon was made heir apparent, granted special advancement and Superior Pillar of State, and given a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-eighth year Seung's son Eon was made heir apparent, granted special advancement and Superior Pillar of State, and given a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 十月，以其國饑，給以米二十萬斛。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, because their country was starving, two hundred thousand piculs of rice were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, because their country was starving, two hundred thousand piculs of rice were granted.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月，賰遣使入奏，復更名昛，及乞功臣號。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirtieth year Seung sent envoys to memorialize, again changing his name to Hoe, and begging a merit title.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirtieth year Seung sent envoys to memorialize, again changing his name to Hoe, and begging a merit title.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「特進、上柱國、開府儀同三司、征東行中書省左丞相、駙馬高麗王昛，世守王爵，選尚我家。

translations.literal: The decree said: "Special advancement, Superior Pillar of State, identical ceremonies with the Three Dukes, Left Chancellor of the Eastern Campaign Secretariat, imperial son-in-law Goryeo King Hoe—guarding the royal fief through generations, chosen to marry into our house.
translations.idiomatic: The decree said, "Special advancement, Superior Pillar of State, identical ceremonies with the Three Dukes, Left Chancellor of the Eastern Campaign Secretariat, imperial son-in-law Goryeo King Hoe—guarding the royal fief through generations, chosen to marry into our house.

sentences.zh: 載旌藩屏之功，宜示褒嘉之寵。

translations.literal: Bearing merit as screen and bulwark of the realm, it is fitting to show commendatory favor.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing merit as screen and bulwark of the realm, it is fitting to show commendatory favor.

sentences.zh: 可賜號推忠宣力定遠功臣，餘如故。

translations.literal: He may be granted the title Merit Lord Who Pushes Loyalty, Displays Power, and Settles the Distance; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: He may be granted the title Merit Lord Who Pushes Loyalty, Displays Power, and Settles the Distance; the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 益懋厥勳，對揚休命。

translations.literal: Further exert your merit and respond to our gracious mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Further exert your merit and respond to our gracious mandate.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，昛入朝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Hoe came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Hoe came to court.

sentences.zh: 成宗元貞二年七月，陞其僉議司為二品。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Yuanzhen 2 of Chengzong their Consultation Office was raised to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Chengzong's Yuanzhen 2 their Consultation Office was raised to second rank.

sentences.zh: 大德元年十一月，封昛為逸壽王，以世子謜為高麗王，從所請也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of Dade 1 Hoe was enfeoffed Prince Yishou; the heir Eon was made Goryeo king, as requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Dade 1 Hoe was enfeoffed Prince Yishou; the heir Eon was made Goryeo king, as requested.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，中書省臣奏謜有罪當廢，復以其父昛為王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of year 2 Secretariat members memorialized Eon had crimes warranting deposition; his father Hoe was again made king.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 2 Secretariat members memorialized that Eon had crimes warranting deposition; his father Hoe was again made king.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，昛遣使入貢。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 3 Hoe sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3 Hoe sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丞相完澤等言：「世祖時，或言高麗僭設省、院、臺，有旨罷之，其國遂改立僉議府、密直司、監察司。

translations.literal: Grand Chancellor Wanze and others said: "In the time of Kublai, some reported that Goryeo had presumptuously established Secretariat, Academy, and Censorate offices; an imperial order abolished them, and the country then established instead the Privy Council, Secret Direct Office, and Supervisory Office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Wanze and others said, "In Kublai's reign, some reported that Goryeo had presumptuously established Secretariat, Academy, and Censorate offices. An imperial order abolished them, and the country then established instead the Privy Council, Secret Direct Office, and Supervisory Office.

sentences.zh: 今謜加其臣趙仁規司徒、司空、侍中之職。

translations.literal: Now Eon has additionally given his minister Zhao Rengui the posts of Minister over the Masses, Minister of Works, and Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Now Eon has additionally given his minister Zhao Rengui the posts of Minister over the Masses, Minister of Works, and Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 又昛給仁規赦九死獎諭文書。

translations.literal: Moreover Hoe gave Rengui a document of pardon for nine capital offenses and commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Hoe gave Rengui a document pardoning nine capital offenses and commending him.

sentences.zh: 又擅寫皇朝帝系，及自造曆，加其女為令妃。

translations.literal: He also on his own authority wrote out the imperial dynasty's line of emperors, created a calendar of his own, and raised his daughter to the rank of chief consort.
translations.idiomatic: He also on his own authority wrote out the imperial dynasty's line of emperors, created a calendar of his own, and raised his daughter to the rank of chief consort.

sentences.zh: 又立資政院，以崔沖紹為興祿大夫。

translations.literal: He also established a Council of State Affairs and made Cui Chongshao Grand Master for Glorious Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: He also established a Council of State Affairs and made Cui Chongshao Grand Master for Glorious Blessings.

sentences.zh: 又嘗奉太后旨，公主與謜兩位下怯薛合併為一。

translations.literal: He also once received the Empress Dowager's order that the keshig of the Princess and of the two households under Eon be merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: He also once received the Empress Dowager's order to merge the keshig of the Princess and of the two households under Eon into one.

sentences.zh: 謜不奉旨。

translations.literal: Eon did not obey the order.
translations.idiomatic: Eon did not obey the order.

sentences.zh: 謜又擅殺千戶金呂而以其金符給宦者朮合兒。

translations.literal: Eon also on his own authority killed the chiliarch Jin Lü and gave his gold tally to the eunuch Shuqe'er.
translations.idiomatic: Eon also on his own authority killed the chiliarch Jin Lü and gave his gold tally to the eunuch Shuqe'er.

sentences.zh: 又仁規進女侍謜，有巫蠱事。

translations.literal: Moreover Rengui presented his daughter to attend Eon, and there was a sorcery affair.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Rengui presented his daughter to attend Eon, and there was a sorcery affair.

sentences.zh: 今乞將仁規、沖紹發付京兆、鞏昌兩路安置，不得他適。

translations.literal: We now beg that Rengui and Chongshao be sent and settled in the two circuits of Jingzhao and Gongchang, and not be permitted to go elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: We now ask that Rengui and Chongshao be sent to settle in the Jingzhao and Gongchang circuits and not be permitted to go elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 昛行事不法，謜年少妄殺無辜，乞降詔戒飭。

translations.literal: Hoe's conduct is unlawful, and Eon in his youth has wantonly killed the innocent; we beg that an edict be issued to admonish and restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Hoe's conduct is unlawful, and the young Eon has wantonly killed the innocent. We ask that an edict be issued to admonish and restrain them.

sentences.zh: 」帝命杖仁規、沖紹而遣之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered Rengui and Chongshao beaten with the staff and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered Rengui and Chongshao beaten with the staff and sent away.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔諭昛并闔境臣民：「自今以始，勉遵守國之規，益謹畏天之戒。

translations.literal: In the second month an edict instructed Hoe and all officials and people throughout his realm: "From this time forward, strive to observe the rules of the state and be ever more reverent of Heaven's warnings.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month an edict instructed Hoe and all officials and people throughout his realm, "From this time forward, strive to observe the rules of the state and be ever more reverent of Heaven's warnings.

sentences.zh: 凡在官者，各勤乃事，協力匡贊，毋蹈前非，自干刑憲。

translations.literal: All who hold office should each diligently perform their duties, working together to assist and support, and not repeat former errors so as to bring punishment upon themselves.
translations.idiomatic: All who hold office should each diligently perform their duties, work together to assist and support, and not repeat former errors so as to bring punishment upon themselves.

sentences.zh: 緇黃士庶，各安其業。」

translations.literal: Monks, clerics, and common people should each rest secure in their occupations."
translations.idiomatic: Monks, clerics, and common people should each rest secure in their occupations."

sentences.zh: 五月，哈散使高麗還，言昛不能服其衆，朝廷宜遣官共理之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Hasan, returning from his mission to Goryeo, said Hoe could not command his people and that the court should dispatch officials to govern jointly with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Hasan, returning from his mission to Goryeo, said Hoe could not command his people and that the court should dispatch officials to govern jointly with him.

sentences.zh: 遂復立征東行省，命闊里吉思為高麗行省平章政事。

translations.literal: The Eastern Campaign Secretariat was then reestablished, and Kuridzhis was appointed Goryeo Secretariat Grand Councillor of State.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Campaign Secretariat was then reestablished, and Kuridzhis was appointed Goryeo Secretariat Grand Councillor of State.

sentences.zh: 九月，昛遣使入貢，以朝廷增置行省，上表陳情，其略言：「累世有勤王之功，凡八十餘年，歲修職貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Hoe sent envoys with tribute; because the court had added a Secretariat, he submitted a memorial stating his case, which in summary said: "For generations we have had merit in supporting the throne; for more than eighty years we have annually paid tribute and performed our duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Hoe sent envoys with tribute. Because the court had added a Secretariat, he submitted a memorial stating his case, which in summary said, "For generations we have had merit in supporting the throne; for more than eighty years we have annually paid tribute and performed our duties.

sentences.zh: 嘗以世子入侍，得聯婚帝室，遂為甥舅，實感至恩。

translations.literal: Our heir once entered court service and obtained marriage with the imperial house, becoming uncle and nephew by marriage; we are deeply grateful for this supreme grace.
translations.idiomatic: Our heir once entered court service and obtained marriage with the imperial house, becoming uncle and nephew by marriage. We are deeply grateful for this supreme grace.

sentences.zh: 使小國不替祖風，永修侯職，是所望也。」

translations.literal: That our small state may not lose the ways of our ancestors and may forever maintain the duties of a vassal is what we hope for."
translations.idiomatic: That our small state may not lose the ways of our ancestors and may forever maintain the duties of a vassal is what we hope for."

sentences.zh: 四年二月，征東行省平章闊里吉思言：「高麗國王自署官府三百五十八所，官四千五十五員，衣食皆取之民，復苛征之。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 4 Eastern Campaign Secretariat Grand Councillor Kuridzhis said: "The Goryeo king on his own authority maintains three hundred fifty-eight offices and four thousand fifty-five officials; their food and clothing all come from the people, and he further levies harsh taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4 Eastern Campaign Secretariat Grand Councillor Kuridzhis said, "The Goryeo king on his own authority maintains three hundred fifty-eight offices and four thousand fifty-five officials. Their food and clothing all come from the people, and he further levies harsh taxes.

sentences.zh: 又其大會，王曲蓋、龍扆、警蹕，諸臣舞蹈山呼，一如朝儀，僭擬過甚。

translations.literal: At his great assemblies the king uses a curved canopy, dragon screen, and imperial escort; his ministers dance and shout "Long live!" just like court ceremony—his presumptuous imitation is excessive.
translations.idiomatic: At his great assemblies the king uses a curved canopy, dragon screen, and imperial escort; his ministers dance and shout "Long live!" just like court ceremony—his presumptuous imitation is excessive.

sentences.zh: 」遣山東宣慰使塔察兒、刑部尚書王泰亨齎詔諭之，使釐正以聞。

translations.literal: " Pacification Commissioner of Shandong Tachar and Minister of Justice Wang Taiheng were sent bearing an edict to instruct him, and to report back after rectifying matters.
translations.idiomatic: " Shandong Pacification Commissioner Tachar and Minister of Justice Wang Taiheng were sent with an edict to instruct him and to report back after rectifying matters.

sentences.zh: 三月，闊里吉思復上言：「僉議司官不肯供報民戶版籍、州縣疆界。

translations.literal: In the third month Kuridzhis again memorialized: "The officials of the Privy Council refuse to supply registers of households and the boundaries of prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Kuridzhis again memorialized, "The officials of the Privy Council refuse to supply registers of households and the boundaries of prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 本國橫科暴斂，民少官多，刑罰不一，若止依本俗行事，實難撫治。」

translations.literal: In our country arbitrary levies and violent exactions prevail; the people are few and officials many, and punishments are not uniform. If we rely only on local custom in administration, it will truly be difficult to govern and pacify."
translations.idiomatic: In our country arbitrary levies and violent exactions prevail; the people are few and officials many, and punishments are not uniform. If we rely only on local custom in administration, it will truly be difficult to govern and pacify."

sentences.zh: 五年二月，為昛罷行省官，有詔諭昛。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 5 the Secretariat officials for Hoe were abolished, and an edict instructed Hoe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 5 the Secretariat officials for Hoe were abolished, and an edict was issued instructing Hoe.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，昛上表言：「昔居海島時，嘗用山呼，後改呼千秋。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn Hoe submitted a memorial saying: "In former days when we lived on the island we once used the shout of 'mountain!' Later we changed it to 'ten thousand years!'"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Hoe submitted a memorial saying, "In former days when we lived on the island we once used the shout of 'mountain!' Later we changed it to 'ten thousand years!'"

sentences.zh: 今既奉明詔，一切皆罷。

translations.literal: Now that we have received the clear edict, all of these have been abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Now that we have received the clear edict, all of these have been abolished.

sentences.zh: 又革官府九十餘所，汰官吏二百七十餘員。

translations.literal: We have also abolished more than ninety offices and eliminated more than two hundred seventy officials.
translations.idiomatic: We have also abolished more than ninety offices and eliminated more than two hundred seventy officials.

sentences.zh: 他如雜徭病民、馹騎煩擾驛傳者，亦皆省之。

translations.literal: Other matters such as miscellaneous corvée that harmed the people and courier horses that troubled the relay stations have also been reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Other matters such as miscellaneous corvée that harmed the people and courier horses that troubled the relay stations have also been reduced.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「卿其諭朕意，所言當始終行之，或有不然，寧不羞懼？」

translations.literal: " An edict said: "You should convey Our intent; what you have stated must be carried out from beginning to end—if not, would you not feel shame and fear?"
translations.idiomatic: " An edict said, "You should convey Our intent; what you have stated must be carried out from beginning to end—if not, would you not feel shame and fear?"

sentences.zh: 昛自大德二年復位，八年而薨。

translations.literal: Hoe resumed the throne in Dade 2 and died after eight years.
translations.idiomatic: Hoe resumed the throne in Dade 2 and died after eight years.

sentences.zh: 子謜復襲王位。

translations.literal: His son Eon again inherited the royal title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Eon again inherited the royal title.

sentences.zh: 成宗初年，尚寶塔實憐公主。

translations.literal: In the early years of Chengzong he married Princess Shililian of the Imperial Treasures Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the early years of Chengzong he married Princess Shililian of the Imperial Treasures Office.

sentences.zh: 十一年，進爵瀋陽王，繼襲位高麗國王，生子燾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was advanced to Prince of Shenyang, succeeded to the title Goryeo king, and had a son named Chao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was advanced to Prince of Shenyang, succeeded to the title Goryeo king, and had a son named Chao.

sentences.zh: 燾受遜位，以仁宗皇慶二年四月封高麗國王。

translations.literal: Chao received the abdication and in the fourth month of Huangqing 2 of Renzong was enfeoffed Goryeo king.
translations.idiomatic: Chao received the abdication and in the fourth month of Huangqing 2 of Renzong was enfeoffed Goryeo king.

sentences.zh: 是年，其弟暠立為世子，以其父瀋陽王請於朝故也。

translations.literal: That year his younger brother Go was established as heir apparent, because his father the Prince of Shenyang had requested it at court.
translations.idiomatic: That year his younger brother Go was established as heir apparent, because his father the Prince of Shenyang had requested it at court.

sentences.zh: 自傳其子禃，禃傳其子昛，昛傳其子謜，謜傳其子燾，燾傳其弟暠。

translations.literal: The line passed from his son Chung to his son Hoe, Hoe to his son Eon, Eon to his son Chao, and Chao to his younger brother Go.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed from his son Chung to his son Hoe, Hoe to his son Eon, Eon to his son Chao, and Chao to his younger brother Go.

sentences.zh: 禃初名倎；

translations.literal: Chung was initially named Tian;
translations.idiomatic: Chung was initially named Tian;

sentences.zh: 昛初名愖，又名賰，後乃名昛；

translations.literal: Hoe was initially named Chen, also named Seung, and later named Hoe;
translations.idiomatic: Hoe was initially named Chen, also named Seung, and later named Hoe;

sentences.zh: 謜則更名璋云。

translations.literal: Eon then changed his name to Zhang, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Eon then changed his name to Zhang, it is said.

sentences.zh: 耽羅，高麗與國也。

translations.literal: Tamna was an allied state of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Tamna was an allied state of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 世祖既臣服高麗，以耽羅為南宋、日本衝要，亦注意焉。

translations.literal: After Kublai had subjugated Goryeo, because Tamna was strategically important for Southern Song and Japan, he also paid attention to it.
translations.idiomatic: After Kublai had subjugated Goryeo, because Tamna was strategically important for Southern Song and Japan, he also paid attention to it.

sentences.zh: 至元六年七月，遣明威將軍都統領脫脫兒、武德將軍統領王國昌、武略將軍副統領劉傑往視耽羅等處道路，詔高麗國王王禃選官導送。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Zhiyuan 6 he sent Bright Authority General Supreme Commander Tuoduo'er, Martial Virtue General Commander Wang Guochang, and Martial Strategy General Vice Commander Liu Jie to inspect the roads at Tamna and elsewhere; an edict ordered Goryeo King Wang Chung to select officials to guide and escort them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Zhiyuan 6 he sent Tuoduo'er, Wang Guochang, and Liu Jie to inspect the roads at Tamna and elsewhere; Goryeo King Wang Chung was ordered to select officials to guide and escort them.

sentences.zh: 時高麗叛賊林衍者，有餘黨金通精遁入耽羅。

translations.literal: At that time among the remnant followers of the Goryeo rebel Lin Yan was Jin Tongjeong, who had fled into Tamna.
translations.idiomatic: At that time among the remnant followers of the Goryeo rebel Lin Yan was Jin Tongjeong, who had fled into Tamna.

sentences.zh: 九年，中書省臣及樞密院臣議曰：「若先有事日本，未見其逆順之情。

translations.literal: In year 9 Secretariat members and Privy Council members deliberated: "If we first take action against Japan, we have not yet seen whether they are compliant or resistant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Secretariat members and Privy Council members deliberated, "If we first take action against Japan, we have not yet seen whether they are compliant or resistant.

sentences.zh: 恐有後辭，可先平耽羅，然後觀日本從否，徐議其事。

translations.literal: We fear there will be excuses afterward; we should first pacify Tamna, then observe whether Japan follows or not, and discuss the matter at leisure.
translations.idiomatic: We fear there will be excuses afterward. We should first pacify Tamna, then observe whether Japan follows or not, and discuss the matter at leisure.

sentences.zh: 且耽羅國王嘗來朝覲，今叛賊逐其主，據其城以亂，舉兵討之，義所先也。」

translations.literal: Moreover the king of Tamna once came to court; now rebels have driven out their lord, seized their city, and raised disorder—raising troops to punish them is what righteousness requires first."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the king of Tamna once came to court; now rebels have driven out their lord, seized their city, and raised disorder. Raising troops to punish them is what righteousness requires first."

sentences.zh: 十年正月，命經略使忻都、史樞及洪茶丘等率兵船大小百有八艘，討耽羅賊黨。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 10 Strategic Commissioner Xindu, Shi Shu, Hong Chaqiu, and others were ordered to lead one hundred eight large and small warships to suppress the Tamna rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 10 Strategic Commissioner Xindu, Shi Shu, Hong Chaqiu, and others were ordered to lead one hundred eight large and small warships to suppress the Tamna rebels.

sentences.zh: 六月，平之，於其地立耽羅國招討司，屯鎮邊軍千七百人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month it was pacified; at that place the Tamna Pacification Office was established, and one thousand seven hundred frontier garrison troops were stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month it was pacified. The Tamna Pacification Office was established there, and one thousand seven hundred frontier garrison troops were stationed.

sentences.zh: 其貢賦歲進毛施布百匹。

translations.literal: Its tribute and levies were one hundred bolts of felt cloth presented annually.
translations.idiomatic: Its tribute and levies were one hundred bolts of felt cloth presented annually.

sentences.zh: 招討司後改為軍民都達魯花赤緫管府，又改為軍民安撫司。

translations.literal: The Pacification Office was later changed to the Military-Civilian Chief Darughachi General Administration, and again changed to the Military-Civilian Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Office was later changed to the Military-Civilian Chief Darughachi General Administration, and again changed to the Military-Civilian Pacification Office.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，高麗王上言，耽羅之地，自祖宗以來臣屬其國；

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the Goryeo king memorialized that the land of Tamna had since the time of their ancestors been subject to their country;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the Goryeo king memorialized that the land of Tamna had since the time of their ancestors been subject to their country;

sentences.zh: 林衍逆黨既平之後，尹邦寶充招討副使，以計求徑隸朝廷，乞仍舊。

translations.literal: after Lin Yan's rebel faction was pacified, Yin Bangbao served as deputy pacification commissioner and by scheming sought direct subordination to the court; he begged that the former arrangement be restored.
translations.idiomatic: after Lin Yan's rebel faction was pacified, Yin Bangbao served as deputy pacification commissioner and by scheming sought direct subordination to the court. He begged that the former arrangement be restored.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此小事，可使還屬高麗。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This is a small matter; it may be returned to Goryeo's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is a small matter; it may be returned to Goryeo's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 」自是遂復隸高麗。

translations.literal: " From this it again came under Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: " From this it again came under Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 元世祖之至元二年，以高麗人趙彝等言日本國可通，擇可奉使者。

translations.literal: In Zhiyuan 2 of Kublai, because the Goryeo men Zhao Yi and others said Japan could be reached, suitable envoys were selected to be sent.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 2 of Kublai, because the Goryeo men Zhao Yi and others said Japan could be reached, suitable envoys were selected to be sent.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，命兵部侍郎黑的，給虎符，充國信使，禮部侍郎殷弘給金符，充國信副使，持國書使日本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 3 Vice Minister of War Hei Di was given a tiger tally and made credentialed envoy; Vice Minister of Rites Yin Hong was given a gold tally and made deputy credentialed envoy; they bore the imperial letter as envoys to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 3 Vice Minister of War Hei Di was given a tiger tally and made credentialed envoy; Vice Minister of Rites Yin Hong was given a gold tally and made deputy credentialed envoy. They bore the imperial letter as envoys to Japan.

sentences.zh: 書曰：

translations.literal: The letter said:
translations.idiomatic: The letter said:

sentences.zh: 大蒙古國皇帝奉書日本國王。

translations.literal: The Emperor of the Great Mongol State sends this letter to the King of Japan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor of the Great Mongol State sends this letter to the King of Japan.

sentences.zh: 朕惟自古小國之君，境土相接，尚務講信修睦。

translations.literal: We consider that since ancient times rulers of small states, when their territories adjoin, still strive to keep faith and cultivate harmony.
translations.idiomatic: We consider that since ancient times rulers of small states, when their territories adjoin, still strive to keep faith and cultivate harmony.

sentences.zh: 況我祖宗，受天明命，奄有區夏，遐方異域畏威懷德者，不可悉數。

translations.literal: How much more so Our ancestors, who received Heaven's clear mandate, encompassed the Central Realm, and drew distant lands and foreign regions to revere Our might and cherish Our virtue— they cannot all be counted.
translations.idiomatic: How much more so Our ancestors, who received Heaven's clear mandate, encompassed the Central Realm, and drew distant lands and foreign regions to revere Our might and cherish Our virtue—they cannot all be counted.

sentences.zh: 朕即位之初，以高麗無辜之民久瘁鋒鏑，即令罷兵還其疆域，反其旄倪。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Our reign, because the innocent people of Goryeo had long suffered under arms, We immediately ordered the armies withdrawn, their territory restored, and their old and young returned.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Our reign, because the innocent people of Goryeo had long suffered under arms, We immediately ordered the armies withdrawn, their territory restored, and their old and young returned.

sentences.zh: 高麗君臣感戴來朝，義雖君臣，歡若父子。

translations.literal: The king and ministers of Goryeo, moved with gratitude, came to court; though the relation was that of lord and subject, their joy was like that of father and son.
translations.idiomatic: The king and ministers of Goryeo, moved with gratitude, came to court; though the relation was that of lord and subject, their joy was like that of father and son.

sentences.zh: 計王之君臣亦已知之。

translations.literal: We reckon that Your Majesty's king and ministers also already know this.
translations.idiomatic: We reckon that Your Majesty's king and ministers also already know this.

sentences.zh: 高麗，朕之東藩也。

translations.literal: Goryeo is Our eastern frontier state.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo is Our eastern frontier state.

sentences.zh: 日本密邇高麗，開國以來亦時通中國，至於朕躬，而無一乘之使以通和好。

translations.literal: Japan lies close to Goryeo; since the founding of your state you have also at times communicated with China—yet in Our own time not a single envoy has been sent to establish friendship.
translations.idiomatic: Japan lies close to Goryeo; since the founding of your state you have also at times communicated with China—yet in Our own time not a single envoy has been sent to establish friendship.

sentences.zh: 尚恐王國知之未審，故特遣使持書，布告朕志，冀自今以往，通問結好，以相親睦。

translations.literal: We still fear Your Majesty's kingdom may not yet have understood this clearly; therefore We specially dispatch envoys bearing a letter to proclaim Our intent, hoping that from now on messengers may pass and friendship be joined, so that we may be close and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: We still fear Your Majesty's kingdom may not yet have understood this clearly; therefore We specially dispatch envoys bearing a letter to proclaim Our intent, hoping that from now on messengers may pass and friendship be joined, so that we may be close and harmonious.

sentences.zh: 且聖人以四海為家，不相通好，豈一家之理哉。

translations.literal: Moreover the sage takes the four seas as one household—if we do not communicate and keep friendship, how can that be the principle of one family?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the sage takes the four seas as one household—if we do not communicate and keep friendship, how can that be the principle of one family?

sentences.zh: 以至用兵，夫孰所好。

translations.literal: As for resorting to arms—who would prefer that?
translations.idiomatic: As for resorting to arms—who would prefer that?

sentences.zh: 王其圖之。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should consider this.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should consider this.

sentences.zh: 黑的等道由高麗，高麗國王王禃以帝命遣其樞密院副使宋君斐、借禮部侍郎金贊等導詔使黑的等往日本，不至而還。

translations.literal: Hei Di and the others traveled by way of Goryeo; Goryeo King Wang Chung, by imperial order, sent his Privy Council Vice Commissioner Song Gunbi and Acting Vice Minister of Rites Kim Chan to guide the imperial envoys Hei Di and the others to Japan; they did not reach Japan and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Hei Di and the others traveled by way of Goryeo. Goryeo King Wang Chung, by imperial order, sent his Privy Council Vice Commissioner Song Gunbi and Acting Vice Minister of Rites Kim Chan to guide the imperial envoys Hei Di and the others to Japan; they did not reach Japan and returned.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，帝謂王禃以辭為解，令去使徒還，復遣黑的等至高麗諭禃，委以日本事，以必得其要領為期。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year 4 the Emperor, finding Wang Chung's words evasive, ordered the departing envoys to return empty-handed; Hei Di and the others were again sent to Goryeo with an edict instructing Chung, entrusting him with Japanese affairs on condition that the essential points must be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 4 the Emperor, finding Wang Chung's words evasive, ordered the departing envoys to return empty-handed. Hei Di and the others were again sent to Goryeo with an edict instructing Chung and entrusting him with Japanese affairs, on condition that the essential points must be obtained.

sentences.zh: 禃以為海道險阻，不可辱天使，九月，遣其起居舍人潘阜等持書往日本，留六月，亦不得其要領而歸。

translations.literal: Chung considered the sea route dangerous and that the imperial envoys must not be disgraced; in the ninth month he sent his Chamberlain for Attendance Pan Fu and others bearing a letter to Japan; they remained six months and likewise returned without obtaining the essential points.
translations.idiomatic: Chung considered the sea route dangerous and that the imperial envoys must not be disgraced. In the ninth month he sent his Chamberlain for Attendance Pan Fu and others with a letter to Japan; they remained six months and likewise returned without obtaining the essential points.

sentences.zh: 五年九月，命黑的、弘復持書往，至對馬島，日本人拒而不納，執其塔二郎、彌二郎二人而還。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of year 5 Hei Di and Hong were again ordered to go bearing a letter; they reached Tsushima, but the Japanese refused them entry and returned having seized the two men Taro and Jiro.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 5 Hei Di and Hong were again ordered to go bearing a letter. They reached Tsushima, but the Japanese refused them entry and returned having seized the two men Taro and Jiro.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，命高麗金有成送還執者，俾中書省牒其國，亦不報。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year 6 the Goryeo man Kim Yucheng was ordered to return the seized men; the Secretariat was also to send a dispatch to that country, but again there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 6 the Goryeo man Kim Yucheng was ordered to return the seized men. The Secretariat was also to send a dispatch to that country, but again there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 有成留其太宰府守護所者久之。

translations.literal: Yucheng remained long at the Dazaifu Guard Office.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng remained long at the Dazaifu Guard Office.

sentences.zh: 十二月，又命祕書監趙良弼往使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Zhao Liangbi of the Secretariat Directorate was again ordered to go as envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhao Liangbi of the Secretariat Directorate was again ordered to go as envoy.

sentences.zh: 書曰：「蓋聞王者無外，高麗與朕既為一家，王國實為鄰境，故嘗馳信使修好，為疆埸之吏抑而弗通。

translations.literal: The letter said: "We have heard that the king has no outside—Goryeo and We are already one family, and Your Majesty's kingdom is truly a neighboring realm; therefore We once sent swift envoys to establish friendship, but the border officials suppressed them and would not let them pass.
translations.idiomatic: The letter said, "We have heard that the king has no outside—Goryeo and We are already one family, and Your Majesty's kingdom is truly a neighboring realm. Therefore We once sent swift envoys to establish friendship, but the border officials suppressed them and would not let them pass.

sentences.zh: 所獲二人，敕有司慰撫，俾齎牒以還，遂復寂無所聞。

translations.literal: The two men who were seized were ordered comforted and cared for by the relevant offices and sent back bearing a dispatch; yet again there was silence and no word.
translations.idiomatic: The two men who were seized were ordered comforted and cared for by the relevant offices and sent back bearing a dispatch; yet again there was silence and no word.

sentences.zh: 繼欲通問，屬高麗權臣林衍構亂，坐是弗果。

translations.literal: We then wished to communicate again, but the Goryeo powerful minister Lin Yan raised disorder, and on that account it did not come to pass.
translations.idiomatic: We then wished to communicate again, but the Goryeo powerful minister Lin Yan raised disorder, and on that account it did not come to pass.

sentences.zh: 豈王亦因此輟不遣使，或已遣而中路梗塞，皆不可知。

translations.literal: Perhaps Your Majesty also on this account ceased to send envoys, or perhaps envoys were sent but blocked on the way—all cannot be known.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps Your Majesty also on this account ceased to send envoys, or perhaps envoys were sent but blocked on the way—all cannot be known.

sentences.zh: 不然，日本素號知禮之國，王之君臣寧肯漫為弗思之事乎。

translations.literal: If not, Japan has long been called a state that knows ritual—would Your Majesty's king and ministers willingly do something so thoughtless?
translations.idiomatic: If not, Japan has long been called a state that knows ritual—would Your Majesty's king and ministers willingly do something so thoughtless?

sentences.zh: 近已滅林衍，復舊王位，安集其民，特命少中大夫祕書監趙良弼充國信使，持書以往。

translations.literal: Recently Lin Yan has been destroyed, the former king restored, and the people settled; We specially appoint Junior Minister and Secretariat Director Zhao Liangbi as credentialed envoy to go bearing a letter.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Lin Yan has been destroyed, the former king restored, and the people settled. We specially appoint Junior Minister and Secretariat Director Zhao Liangbi as credentialed envoy to go bearing a letter.

sentences.zh: 如即發使與之偕來，親仁善鄰，國之美事。

translations.literal: If you immediately send envoys to come together with him, cherishing benevolence and being good neighbors—this is a fine thing for a state.
translations.idiomatic: If you immediately send envoys to come together with him, cherishing benevolence and being good neighbors—this is a fine thing for a state.

sentences.zh: 其或猶豫以至用兵，夫誰所樂為也，王其審圖之。

translations.literal: If you still hesitate until it comes to using troops—who would rejoice in that? Your Majesty should consider this carefully.
translations.idiomatic: If you still hesitate until it comes to using troops—who would rejoice in that? Your Majesty should consider this carefully.

sentences.zh: 」良弼將往，乞定與其王相見之儀。

translations.literal: " When Liangbi was about to depart, he begged that the protocol for meeting their king be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: " When Liangbi was about to depart, he begged that the protocol for meeting their king be fixed.

sentences.zh: 廷議與其國上下之分未定，無禮數可言。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held that the superior and inferior status of that country was not yet settled, and no ritual protocol could be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Court deliberation held that the superior and inferior status of that country was not yet settled, and no ritual protocol could be discussed.

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，詔諭高麗王禃送國信使趙良弼通好日本，期於必達。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of year 7 an edict instructed Goryeo King Chung to escort the credentialed envoy Zhao Liangbi to establish friendship with Japan, with the deadline that he must reach Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 7 an edict instructed Goryeo King Chung to escort the credentialed envoy Zhao Liangbi to establish friendship with Japan, with the deadline that he must reach Japan.

sentences.zh: 仍以忽林失、王國昌、洪茶丘將兵送抵海上，比國信使還，姑令金州等處屯駐。

translations.literal: Hulinsi, Wang Guochang, and Hong Chaqiu were also ordered to lead troops escorting them to the sea; when the credentialed envoy returned, they were for the time being to garrison at Jin Prefecture and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Hulinsi, Wang Guochang, and Hong Chaqiu were also ordered to lead troops escorting them to the sea. When the credentialed envoy returned, they were for the time being to garrison at Jin Prefecture and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，日本通事曹介升等上言：「高麗迂路導引國使，外有捷徑，倘得便風半日可到。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year 8 the Japanese interpreter Cao Jiesheng and others memorialized: "Goryeo guides the imperial envoys by a roundabout route; there is a shorter path outside, and with a favorable wind one can arrive in half a day.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 8 the Japanese interpreter Cao Jiesheng and others memorialized, "Goryeo guides the imperial envoys by a roundabout route; there is a shorter path outside, and with a favorable wind one can arrive in half a day.

sentences.zh: 若使臣去，則不敢同往；

translations.literal: If envoys go, then I dare not go together with them;
translations.idiomatic: If envoys go, then I dare not go together with them;

sentences.zh: 若大軍進征，則願為鄉導。

translations.literal: if a great army advances, then I am willing to serve as guide.
translations.idiomatic: if a great army advances, then I am willing to serve as guide.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「如此則當思之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "If so, then this should be considered.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "If so, then this should be considered.

sentences.zh: 」九月，高麗王禃遣其通事別將徐偁導送良弼使日本，日本始遣彌四郎者入朝，帝宴勞遣之。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month Goryeo King Chung sent his interpreting vice commandant Seo Eung to guide and escort Liangbi's mission to Japan; Japan for the first time sent Yonshiro to come to court, and the Emperor feasted and rewarded him before sending him away.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month Goryeo King Chung sent his interpreting vice commandant Seo Eung to guide and escort Liangbi's mission to Japan. Japan for the first time sent Yonshiro to come to court, and the Emperor feasted and rewarded him before sending him away.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，樞密院臣言：「奉使日本趙良弼遣書狀官張鐸來言，去歲九月，與日本國人彌四郎等至太宰府西守護所。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 9 Privy Council members said: "Zhao Liangbi, sent on mission to Japan, dispatched document officer Zhang Duo to report that last year in the ninth month he reached the Western Guard Office of Dazaifu together with the Japanese Yonshiro and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 9 Privy Council members said, "Zhao Liangbi, sent on mission to Japan, dispatched document officer Zhang Duo to report that last year in the ninth month he reached the Western Guard Office of Dazaifu together with the Japanese Yonshiro and others.

sentences.zh: 守者云，曩為高麗所紿，屢言上國來伐；

translations.literal: The guards said that formerly they had been deceived by Goryeo, repeatedly saying the superior state was coming to attack;
translations.idiomatic: The guards said that formerly they had been deceived by Goryeo, repeatedly saying the superior state was coming to attack;

sentences.zh: 豈期皇帝好生惡殺，先遣行人下示璽書，然王京去此尚遠，願先遣人從奉使回報。

translations.literal: who could have expected that the Emperor loves life and hates killing, and first sent envoys bearing the imperial letter to show his intent? Yet the royal capital is still far from here; we wish first to send people to return with the envoy and report back.
translations.idiomatic: who could have expected that the Emperor loves life and hates killing, and first sent envoys bearing the imperial letter to show his intent? Yet the royal capital is still far from here; we wish first to send people to return with the envoy and report back.

sentences.zh: 」良弼乃遣鐸同其使二十六人至京師求見。

translations.literal: " Liangbi then sent Duo together with their envoys, twenty-six men, to the capital to request an audience.
translations.idiomatic: " Liangbi then sent Duo together with their envoys, twenty-six men, to the capital to request an audience.

sentences.zh: 帝疑其國主使之來，云守護所者詐也。

translations.literal: The Emperor suspected their king had sent them, saying those at the guardianship office were deceiving.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor suspected their king had sent them, holding that those at the guardianship office were deceiving.

sentences.zh: 詔翰林承旨和禮霍孫以問姚樞、許衡等，皆對曰：「誠如聖筭。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hanlin academician ex officio Helihuosun to consult Yao Shu, Xu Heng, and others; all replied: "It is truly as Your Majesty calculated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hanlin academician ex officio Helihuosun to consult Yao Shu, Xu Heng, and others; all replied, "It is truly as Your Majesty calculated.

sentences.zh: 彼懼我加兵，故發此輩伺吾強弱耳。

translations.literal: They fear we will add troops, so they send these men to spy on our strength or weakness.
translations.idiomatic: They fear we will add troops, so they send these men to spy on our strength or weakness.

sentences.zh: 宜示之寬仁，且不宜聽其入見。

translations.literal: We should show them broad kindness, and for the time being they should not be allowed audience.
translations.idiomatic: We should show them broad kindness, and for the time being they should not be allowed audience.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: This was followed.

sentences.zh: 是月，高麗王禃致書日本。

translations.literal: That month Goryeo King Chung sent a letter to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Goryeo King Wang Chung sent a letter to Japan.

sentences.zh: 五月，又以書往，令必通好大朝，皆不報。

translations.literal: In the fifth month another letter was sent, ordering them to open relations with the great court—there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month another letter was sent, ordering them to open relations with the great court—there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，趙良弼復使日本，至太宰府而還。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year Zhao Liangbi again went as envoy to Japan, reaching Dazaifu and returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year Zhao Liangbi again went as envoy to Japan, reached Dazaifu, and returned.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月，命鳳州經略使忻都、高麗軍民緫管洪茶丘，以千料舟、拔都魯輕疾舟、汲水小舟各三百，共九百艘，載士卒一萬五千，期以七月征日本。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year Strategic Commissioner Xindu of Feng Prefecture and Goryeo military-civilian commander Hong Chaqiu were ordered, with nine hundred vessels—thousand-picul ships, Badulu swift light boats, and water-drawing small boats, three hundred of each—to carry fifteen thousand soldiers, with a deadline of the seventh month to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eleventh year Strategic Commissioner Xindu of Feng Prefecture and Goryeo military-civilian commander Hong Chaqiu were ordered to assemble nine hundred vessels—three hundred thousand-picul ships, three hundred Badulu swift light boats, and three hundred water-drawing small boats—to carry fifteen thousand soldiers, with a deadline of the seventh month to campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，入其國，敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter they entered that country and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter they entered Japan and defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 而官軍不整，又矢盡，惟虜掠四境而歸。

translations.literal: But the official army was not in order, and arrows were exhausted; they only raided the four borders and returned.
translations.idiomatic: But the official army was disordered and arrows ran out; they only raided the four borders and returned.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，遣禮部侍郎杜世忠、兵部侍郎何文著、計議官撒都魯丁往。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twelfth year Vice Minister of Rites Du Shizhong, Vice Minister of War He Wenzhe, and planning officer Saduding were sent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twelfth year Vice Minister of Rites Du Shizhong, Vice Minister of War He Wenzhe, and planning officer Saduding were sent.

sentences.zh: 使復致書，亦不報。

translations.literal: The envoys again sent letters; again there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys again sent letters; again there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 十四年，日本遣商人持金來易銅錢，許之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Japanese merchants came bearing gold to exchange for copper cash; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Japanese merchants came bearing gold to exchange for copper cash; this was permitted.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月，日本殺國使杜世忠等。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventeenth year Japan killed the imperial envoys Du Shizhong and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventeenth year Japan killed the imperial envoys Du Shizhong and others.

sentences.zh: 征東元帥忻都、洪茶丘請自率兵往討，廷議姑少緩之。

translations.literal: Eastern Campaign Marshal Xindu and Hong Chaqiu begged to lead troops personally to punish them; court deliberation was to delay for the time being.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Campaign Marshal Xindu and Hong Chaqiu begged to lead troops personally to punish them; the court decided to delay for the time being.

sentences.zh: 五月，召范文虎，議征日本。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Fan Wenhu was summoned to deliberate on campaigning against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Fan Wenhu was summoned to deliberate on campaigning against Japan.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔募征日本士卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month an edict recruited soldiers for the Japan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict recruited soldiers for the Japan campaign.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，命日本行省右丞相阿剌罕、右丞范文虎及忻都、洪茶丘等率十萬人征日本。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year Japan Secretariat Right Chancellor Alahan, Vice Chancellor Fan Wenhu, and Xindu, Hong Chaqiu, and others were ordered to lead one hundred thousand men against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighteenth year Japan Secretariat Right Chancellor Alahan, Vice Chancellor Fan Wenhu, and Xindu, Hong Chaqiu, and others were ordered to lead one hundred thousand men against Japan.

sentences.zh: 二月，諸將陛辭。

translations.literal: In the second month the generals took leave at audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the generals took leave at audience.

sentences.zh: 帝敕曰：「始因彼國使來，故朝廷亦遣使往，彼遂留我使不還，故使卿輩為此行。

translations.literal: The Emperor charged them: "At first because their country's envoys came, the court also sent envoys; they then detained our envoys and did not return them, therefore I send you on this expedition.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor charged them, "At first because their country's envoys came, the court also sent envoys; they detained our envoys and did not return them—therefore I send you on this expedition.

sentences.zh: 朕聞漢人言，取人家國，欲得百姓土地，若盡殺百姓，徒得地何用。

translations.literal: I have heard Han people say that in taking another's state and land one wants the people's territory; if one kills all the people, what use is the land alone?
translations.idiomatic: I have heard Han people say that in taking another's state one wants the people and the land; if one kills all the people, what use is the land alone?

sentences.zh: 又有一事，朕實憂之，恐卿輩不和耳。

translations.literal: There is also one matter I truly worry about—that you may not be in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: There is also one matter I truly worry about—that you may not be in harmony.

sentences.zh: 假若彼國人至，與卿輩有所議，當同心協謀，如出一口荅之。

translations.literal: If people of that country come and discuss matters with you, you must deliberate in one mind and answer as with one mouth.
translations.idiomatic: If people of that country come and discuss matters with you, you must deliberate in one mind and answer as with one mouth.

sentences.zh: 」五月，日本行省參議裴國佐等言：「本省右丞相阿剌罕、范右丞、李左丞先與忻都、茶丘入朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Japan Secretariat participant Pei Guozuo and others said: "Our secretariat's Right Chancellor Alahan, Vice Chancellor Fan, and Left Chancellor Li first entered court together with Xindu and Chaqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Japan Secretariat participant Pei Guozuo and others said, "Our secretariat's Right Chancellor Alahan, Vice Chancellor Fan, and Left Chancellor Li first entered court together with Xindu and Chaqiu.

sentences.zh: 時同院官議定，領舟師至高麗金州，與忻都、茶丘軍會，然後入征日本。

translations.literal: At that time colleagues in the secretariat deliberated and decided to lead the fleet to Jin Prefecture in Goryeo, join Xindu and Chaqiu's armies, and then enter to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time colleagues in the secretariat decided to lead the fleet to Jin Prefecture in Goryeo, join Xindu and Chaqiu's armies, and then campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 又為風水不便，再議定會於一岐島。

translations.literal: Because winds and tides were unfavorable, it was again decided to meet at Iki Island.
translations.idiomatic: Because winds and tides were unfavorable, it was again decided to meet at Iki Island.

sentences.zh: 今年三月，有日本船為風水漂至者，令其水工畫地圖，因見近太宰府西有平戶島者，周圍皆水，可屯軍船。

translations.literal: This year in the third month, when a Japanese ship was driven by wind and tide to drift here, their sailors were made to draw a map; thereby near west of Dazaifu was seen Hirado Island, surrounded by water on all sides, where military ships could be stationed.
translations.idiomatic: This year in the third month, when a Japanese ship was driven here by wind and tide, their sailors were made to draw a map; thereby Hirado Island was seen west of Dazaifu, surrounded by water, where military ships could be stationed.

sentences.zh: 此島非其所防，若徑往據此島，使人乘船往一岐，呼忻都、茶丘來會進討為利。

translations.literal: This island is not what they defend; if we go straight to occupy it and send men by ship to Iki to summon Xindu and Chaqiu to join in advance and attack, it will be advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: This island is not what they defend; if we go straight to occupy it and send men by ship to Iki to summon Xindu and Chaqiu to join the advance, it will be advantageous.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此間不悉彼中事宜，阿剌罕輩必知，令其自處之。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "We here do not know the affairs of their country in detail; Alahan and the others must know—let them handle it themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "We here do not know their country's affairs in detail; Alahan and the others must know—let them handle it themselves.

sentences.zh: 」六月，阿剌罕以病不能行，命阿塔海代緫軍事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Alahan could not travel because of illness; Atahai was ordered to take overall military command in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Alahan could not travel because of illness; Atahai was ordered to take overall military command in his place.
