sentences.zh: 八月，諸將未見敵，喪全師以還，乃言：「至日本，欲攻太宰府，暴風破舟，猶欲議戰，萬戶厲德彪、招討王國佐、水手緫管陸文政等不聽節制，輒逃去。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the generals had not seen the enemy and lost the whole army in returning; they then said: "Reaching Japan, we wished to attack Dazaifu; a violent wind wrecked the boats; we still wished to deliberate on fighting, but ten-thousand-household chief Li Debiao, campaign commander Wang Guozuo, sailors' commander Lu Wenzheng, and others would not obey orders and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the generals had not seen the enemy and lost the whole army in returning; they said, "Reaching Japan we wished to attack Dazaifu; a violent wind wrecked the boats; we still wished to fight, but ten-thousand-household chief Li Debiao, campaign commander Wang Guozuo, sailors' commander Lu Wenzheng, and others would not obey orders and fled.

sentences.zh: 本省載餘軍至合浦，散遣還鄉里。

translations.literal: Our secretariat carried the remaining army to Hepu and dispersed them to return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat carried the remaining army to Hepu and dispersed them to return home.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，敗卒于閶脫歸，言：「官軍六月入海，七月至平壺島，移五龍山。

translations.literal: Before long defeated soldiers Chang Tuo and others returned, saying: "The official army entered the sea in the sixth month, reached Hirado Island in the seventh month, and moved to Mount Goryo.
translations.idiomatic: Before long defeated soldiers Chang Tuo and others returned, saying, "The official army entered the sea in the sixth month, reached Hirado Island in the seventh month, and moved to Mount Goryo.

sentences.zh: 八月一日，風破舟。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month wind wrecked the boats.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month wind wrecked the boats.

sentences.zh: 五日，文虎等諸將各自擇堅好船乘之，棄士卒十餘萬于山下。

translations.literal: On the fifth day Wenhu and the other generals each chose sturdy good boats and boarded them, abandoning more than one hundred thousand soldiers on the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day Wenhu and the other generals each chose sturdy boats and boarded them, abandoning more than one hundred thousand soldiers on the mountain.

sentences.zh: 衆議推張百戶者為主帥，號之曰張緫管，聽其約束。

translations.literal: The masses deliberated and pushed Zhang the hundred-household chief as commander, calling him Commander Zhang, and obeyed his constraints.
translations.idiomatic: The masses chose Zhang the hundred-household chief as commander, calling him Commander Zhang, and obeyed his orders.

sentences.zh: 方伐木作舟欲還，七日，日本人來戰，盡死。

translations.literal: Just as they were felling trees to make boats intending to return, on the seventh day Japanese came to fight and all died.
translations.idiomatic: Just as they were felling trees to make boats intending to return, on the seventh day the Japanese attacked and all were killed.

sentences.zh: 餘二三萬為其虜去。

translations.literal: The remaining twenty or thirty thousand were taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining twenty or thirty thousand were taken captive.

sentences.zh: 九日，至八角島，盡殺蒙古、高麗、漢人，謂新附軍為唐人，不殺而奴之。

translations.literal: On the ninth day they reached Hakkaku Island; they killed all Mongols, Goryeo people, and Han people, but called the newly attached troops Tang people, did not kill them, and enslaved them.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day they reached Hakkaku Island; they killed all Mongols, Goryeo people, and Han people, but called the newly attached troops Tang people, spared them, and enslaved them.

sentences.zh: 閶輩是也。

translations.literal: Chang and his companions are such.
translations.idiomatic: Chang and his companions are among these.

sentences.zh: 」蓋行省官議事不相下，故皆棄軍歸。

translations.literal: This was because secretariat officials could not agree in deliberation, so all abandoned the army and returned.
translations.idiomatic: This was because secretariat officials could not agree in deliberation, so all abandoned the army and returned.

sentences.zh: 久之，莫青與吳萬五者亦逃還，十萬之衆得還者三人耳。

translations.literal: After a long time Mo Qing and Wu Wanwu also escaped back; of the one hundred thousand only three returned.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time Mo Qing and Wu Wanwu also escaped back; of the one hundred thousand only three returned.

sentences.zh: 二十年，命阿塔海為日本省丞相，與徹里帖木兒右丞、劉二拔都兒左丞，募兵造舟，欲復征日本。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Atahai was made Japan Secretariat chancellor, with Cheilitiemuer as vice chancellor and Liu Erbadu'er as left chancellor, to recruit troops and build boats, intending again to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Atahai was made Japan Secretariat chancellor, with Cheilitiemuer as vice chancellor and Liu Erbadu'er as left chancellor, to recruit troops and build boats, intending again to campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 淮西宣慰使昂吉兒上言民勞，乞寢兵。

translations.literal: Huaixi pacification commissioner Angi'er memorialized that the people were exhausted and begged to suspend troops.
translations.idiomatic: Huaixi pacification commissioner Angi'er memorialized that the people were exhausted and begged to suspend the campaign.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，又以其俗尚佛，遣王積翁與補陀僧如智往使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, because their custom honored Buddhism, Wang Jiweng and the Putuo monk Ruzhi were sent as envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, because their custom honored Buddhism, Wang Jiweng and the Putuo monk Ruzhi were sent as envoys.

sentences.zh: 舟中有不願行者，共謀殺積翁，不果至。

translations.literal: Among those on the boats who were unwilling to go, some plotted to kill Jiweng and did not reach Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Among those on the boats who were unwilling to go, some plotted to kill Jiweng and the mission did not reach Japan.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，帝曰：「日本未嘗相侵，今交趾犯邊，宜置日本，專事交趾。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Emperor said: "Japan has never invaded us; now Jiaozhi offends the border—we should set Japan aside and focus on Jiaozhi."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the Emperor said, "Japan has never invaded us; now Jiaozhi offends the border—we should set Japan aside and focus on Jiaozhi."

sentences.zh: 成宗大德二年，江浙省平章政事也速荅兒乞用兵日本。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chengzong's Dade era, Jiangzhe Circuit pacification commissioner Yesudar begged to use troops against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengzong's Dade 2, Jiangzhe Circuit pacification commissioner Yesudar begged to use troops against Japan.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「今非其時，朕徐思之。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Now is not the time; I shall think on it slowly."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Now is not the time; I shall think on it slowly."

sentences.zh: 三年，遣僧寧一山者，加妙慈弘濟大師，附商舶往使日本，而日本人竟不至。

translations.literal: In the third year the monk Ningyishan was sent, granted the title Great Master Miaoci Hongji, to go as envoy to Japan attached to a merchant ship, but the Japanese in the end did not come.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the monk Ningyishan was sent, granted the title Great Master Miaoci Hongji, to go as envoy to Japan on a merchant ship, but the Japanese in the end did not come.
